page.text:
By induction, a group homomorphism preserves all integer powers:
$\varphi(x^n) = \varphi(x)^n$ for all $n \in \mathbb{Z}$. Because the
preservation of the identity, inverses, and powers is an inescapable
deductive consequence of multiplicativity, it is unnecessary to stipulate
these preservation properties as axioms in the definition of a
homomorphism.
